note: Set B is identical to Set A except for one additional claim — D5 / FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 5 section W10X15 — which is supported by the D5 detail in the text layer and image. All other claims are shared, including the same misbindings (e.g., ø 3" attributed to B1 when the ø 3" openings appear in the W8X13 details C1/A1) and the same vague 'beam opening' claims and duplicated 5'-0"/5 ft and 6" claims. Since the shared claims are equally good or bad, B's one extra correct, well-bound claim makes it the better set.
remarks: Both sets bind ø 3" to 'B1 FLOOR BEAM NEAR GRID 5', but the ø 3" openings appear with the W8X13 details (C1 ROOF BEAM @ GRID 6 & NEAR GRID 5, A1 FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 6), not the W10X15 B1 detail. Both sets also duplicate the 5'-0" length and 6" opening dimension under two names and leave several claims as vague 'beam opening'/'opening/spacing' entities. Important fact both sets miss: the general sheet note '1/2" RADIUS AROUND EDGES OF OPENINGS IN BEAMS', and the W8X13 sections for details C1/A1. The 3'-7" and 5'-0" dimensions appear in the B1/E6 detail blocks in the text layer, so their binding to GRID 5 / GRID 4 is doubtful but hard to verify from the low-resolution image alone.
